name: Ōbu (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Ōbu city emblem in white: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised character of curved strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Ōbu, a city in Aichi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 1958.

features.role: Ōbu city emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised character of curved strokes
